primary.signature_dishes_base: Ersi (Rice Cake Noodles) (饵丝), Ersi Block (饵块), Yunnan-style Rice Noodles
primary.signature_dishes_local: 饵丝, 饵块, 米线
primary.notes_base: Early start for the Erhai Lake day. Ersi noodles are the quintessential Yunnan breakfast - must-try on the Erhai cycling day. This long-established Zhao Family shop is a local institution. Quick and delicious fuel before the lake circuit.
primary.notes_local: 洱海环湖日早起，先吃一碗赵家饵丝。饵丝是大理最地道的早餐，古城老字号，本地人排队光顾，快速简单又好吃。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 洱海鲜鱼, 烤鱼, 白族酸菜, 野生菌
primary.notes_base: Lunch at Shuanglang, a hidden gem private kitchen near the beach. Fresh local fish from the lake, casual setting, great for a relaxed beach lunch. A real local spot, not a tourist trap.
primary.notes_local: 双廊沙滩游后在附近吃午饭，吃货私房菜是双廊真正的本地小馆，洱海新鲜鱼是主打，环境随意，价格实惠，不坑游客。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 白族五花肉, 洱海鲤鱼, 云南火腿, 当地野菜
primary.notes_base: After the long Erhai Lake circuit day, return to Dali Old Town for a traditional Bai minority dinner. This old-style restaurant opposite the Erhai Gate has genuine character. Tired legs, warm meal, happy couple.
primary.notes_local: 洱海环湖一天后，回到古城洱海门附近吃传统白族晚饭。这家老店有真正的老式大理风情，走路就能到。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 破酥粑粑, 甜咸两种口味, 豆浆
primary.notes_base: Start the Xizhou day with the most famous local breakfast: Xizhou Baba! Deshenghe is one of the most authentic spots in Xizhou Ancient Town's main square. The crispy layered flatbread fresh off the griddle is a Dali must-eat experience.
primary.notes_local: 喜洲日从吃最正宗的破酥粑粑开始！德生和就在喜洲四方街，现做现烤，酥脆层叠，甜咸皆有，是大理不可错过的早点体验。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 白族三蒸, 洱海鱼, 白族薄荷肉, 腌菜
primary.notes_base: Lunch in Xizhou, just steps from the main square. This Bai cuisine restaurant is authentic and uses local Xizhou ingredients. After the Baba breakfast, explore the ancient town then settle in for a proper Bai minority meal.
primary.notes_local: 喜洲午饭，就在四方街附近，鸿紫是喜洲本地白族菜馆，食材本地采购，白族三蒸和薄荷肉是特色，吃完继续逛喜洲古镇。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 气锅鸡, 白族豆花, 石板腊肉, 时令云南蔬菜
primary.notes_base: Last proper dinner in Dali - make it special. Junyun Feast is an elevated Bai private kitchen that balances tradition with beautiful presentation. The steam-pot chicken is Yunnan's most iconic dish. A fitting farewell dinner to four wonderful days in Dali.
primary.notes_local: 大理最后一顿正式晚餐，选聚云宴白族私房菜，菜品精致，兼顾传统与颜值。气锅鸡是云南第一名菜，石板腊肉是绝配。明天就要离开，今晚好好吃一顿。

primary.signature_dishes_local: 云南小粒咖啡, 拿铁, 轻食早午餐
primary.notes_base: Last morning in Dali. Shanban Coffee is one of Dali's best-known independent coffee spots. Have a slow farewell coffee before the morning wander. Yunnan coffee is world-class, and this is your last chance before flying home.
primary.notes_local: 大理最后一个早晨！山坂咖啡是大理最有代表性的独立咖啡品牌，云南小粒咖啡是当地骄傲。飞回北京前在这里慢慢喝最后一杯，告别大理。

primary.notes_local: 大理最后一顿饭，在古城附近，前往机场前吃完。南诏宫主是本地白族私房菜，安静不嘈杂，让回程的心情平和又满足。
